description: Returns the parts a screen of a given kind needs in order to be complete, and the contract for reporting them. This is the COMPLETENESS axis — "does this screen have the parts screens of its kind need". It is not the distinction axis: acceptance_bar and score_ui answer "is this designed". Report the two side by side; never fold coverage into a score, a count or a percentage. Report-only — coverage never gates and never fails a build. Archetypes: data-table, settings, search-filter, detail-view, empty-first-run, billing, pricing, docs-page, checkout, onboarding, destructive-confirm, invite-share. Call with no archetype to get the catalogue. dashboard, landing and auth are served by acceptance_bar instead. Returns DATA only — no scoring or judgment.

archetype.description: Screen archetype to retrieve coverage parts for. Accepts the key, the label, or a synonym ("table", "plans", "are you sure"). Omit to list the catalogue.
